company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech providing business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance to exporters. It operates in the financial services sector, helping businesses manage international payments and trade-related financial needs.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing context and supporting colleagues across teams, taking responsibility and learning from problems, and simplifying work to respond quickly to clients. Halden Pay promotes career development through clear career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring. Its working environment is generally hybrid, with many offices meeting in person three days a week; collaboration and team events are part of its approach across around 40 offices.

Employee feedback describes colleagues as friendly and the culture as commercially driven. Reviews also suggest that onboarding and training can vary between teams, and culture ratings are slightly below those of comparable financial services companies.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
